consequence.statement: cert-manager now skips Gateway TLS listeners in Passthrough mode, so Gateways with a TLS listener in Passthrough mode are handled differently than in previous releases.
consequence.remediation: Review Gateway TLS listeners configured with Passthrough mode if you relied on cert-manager processing them.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.18.0, Gateway TLS listeners configured in Passthrough mode are skipped by cert-manager instead of being processed.
